This '''individual''' was a [[Diathim/Legends|Diathim]] native to [[Millius Prime/Legends|Millius Prime]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Millius Prime, the rest of Iego's moons, and the planet itself were invaded by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The Confederate forces pushed the Diathim inhabitants off of Millius Prime, causing them to seek refuge on the planet below. This particular Diathim took up temporary residence in the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Cliffhold/Legends|Cliffhold]], where she later met with [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] during their [[Mission to Iego/Legends|mission]] to free the people of Iego from the malevolent [[Deity/Legends|god]] called "[[Drol/Legends|Drol]]." After hearing from the Diathim refugee, the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] deduced that Drol was not a god, but in fact a Confederate [[LaserWeb Defense Station/Legends|LaserWeb Defense Station]] whose primary node was located on Millius Prime. The two succeeded in destroying the station and freeing the people of Iego.
